slides.title: Half of Cyber Roles Stay Unfilled
slides.subtitle: The market isn't too competitive. It's too empty.

bullets: Most listings sit open for 3-6 months
The talent gap is your window - not a wall
Get in before it fills up

caption: Half of open cyber roles stay unfilled for 6+ months. Not because candidates aren't out there - because companies can't find people who are ready. The job market isn't too competitive. It's too empty. That gap is yours. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #jobmarket #cypherjobs #infosec
